title: A proof of the Bollobás–Nikiforov conjecture in Lean
summary: A complete Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the Bollobás–Nikiforov conjecture (2007) and of the matrix theorems that prove it. Let G be a finite simple graph with adjacency eigenvalues lambda_1 >= lambda_2 >= ..., m edges and clique number omega(G). The conjecture states that every noncomplete graph on at least two vertices satisfies lambda_1^2 + lambda_2^2 <= 2 (1 - 1/omega(G)) m. The formalization proves it (BN.lambda1_sq_add_lambda2_sq_le) as a consequence of a weighted spectral inequality: for every symmetric entrywise nonnegative matrix B with zero diagonal supported on the edges of G,…
